content.introduction: The Asian Pacific stock indices reported varied changes as of 11:25 PM EDT. The Shanghai SE Composite Index increased by 1.48 to 3,905.20, while the Shenzhen SE Composite Index rose by 5.79 to 2,650.16. The ChiNext Index saw a significant increase of 44.67 to 3,540.26. The CSI 300 Index climbed by 26.30 to 4,619.05. The Shenzhen Component Index went up by 97.62 to 14,070.40. The SSE 50 Index and SSE 180 Index both saw minor increases of 6.26 and 9.45 respectively. These figures reflect the market activity as of the specified time.
